mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (current value) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE rising above 5.8%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 2% in the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply contraction regime (as indicated by a 3-month decline in industrial production), manufacturing output slowdowns reduce corporate profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during supply contraction regimes (INDPRO declines > 3% in 3 months), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 137,000 thousand, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL rising above 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a 'hawkish easing' monetary policy where the central bank cuts rates to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a demand slowdown regime (as indicated by a quarterly decline in real GDP growth), reduced economic activity lowers corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during demand slowdown regimes (GDPC1 declines > 0.5% QoQ), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
